workPackage: 阶段1：冻结非技能 fixture 规格与验收矩阵

thisStage: 冻结 fixture 数据形状
冻结 document-contract-v1 最小 grammar

nestedSchemaRequirements.authority: nested-schema-v1 is the sole UI projection source

selectorLimits: only current candidate document, target collection, entry and parent context

derivedOutputs.persistence: never written back to candidate document

shape: workflows exists and is a non-empty array
workflow_id is non-empty and unique in workflows
every workflow has a non-empty steps array
branch has both on_match and on_no_match
derived: step_count equals count(steps) and is displayed as a non-persistent summary

multipleContracts.purpose: prove exact token admission for two path-and-collection matched contracts

serverAdmissionRequirements: enumerate every active document-contract-v1 binding by projectId plus dataSourceId plus normalized path before reading candidate collections
treat binding.match.collection as validator target, not an optional candidate-discovered gate
run allowMissing/type rules for absent or reshaped target collections
require request documentContracts token set to equal server-enumerated binding set exactly
run candidate validation and generation/manifest/compiled-contract/ETag rechecks inside commit mutex before replace
on post-replace drift write recovery_pending and do not publish success or perform speculative rollback
use the same admission/compiler/recovery path for ordinary save, batch save, primary-key sync and identity promotion

acceptanceMatrix.case: missing, partial, extra or stale token set
acceptanceMatrix.expected: missing returns DOCUMENT_CONTRACT_TOKEN_MISSING; non-exact set returns DOCUMENT_CONTRACT_TOKEN_STALE

acceptanceMatrix.case: candidate deletes workflows, changes it to object, or empties it
acceptanceMatrix.expected: path-matched contracts remain active and contract blocks invalid candidate

acceptanceMatrix.case: duplicate workflow_id, empty steps, missing branch outcome
acceptanceMatrix.expected: stable issue code and path; save blocked

acceptanceMatrix.case: switch message, delay and branch variants
acceptanceMatrix.expected: nested-schema-v1 defaults and field conditions apply without domain path checks
summary renders but source JSON is unchanged
journaled save updates fixture copy and document ETag

acceptanceMatrix.case: manifest or contract changes before/after replace
acceptanceMatrix.expected: pre-replace rejects; post-replace enters recovery_pending with no success publication
only scratch fixture changes; no Nocturnel or formal data is touched

knownCoverageDefect.finding: an early return leaves legacy gate, stale and recovery assertions unreachable
knownCoverageDefect.requiredAction: do not treat those assertions as coverage; replace with reachable generic workflow tests in stage2
